scenarios.prompt: An eligible state starts a new cycle with selective carry and a new difficulty profile. Define cycle identity and carry manifest.

criteria.identity: cycle_id/revision and entry predicate are explicit.
criteria.carry: carry_manifest uses stable state IDs with migration/backward-compatibility policy.
criteria.idempotency: Cycle creation is idempotent and does not duplicate/drop carried state.
